content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Natural gas producer and power generator in Texas; Par Pacific is a refiner and fuel marketer, a different business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Regulated gas and electric utility with propane; utility rate-based earnings differ from refining and fuel marketing."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Residential and farm propane distribution with appliance services; no refining and no refined motor fuel or aviation fuel sales."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Oilfield specialty chemicals and well analytics sold to producers; a different business from refining and fuel marketing."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Midstream gas gathering and processing for Permian producers; shares pipeline assets but not refining or fuel sales to end buyers."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures engines and generator sets sold to equipment makers; not a refiner or fuel distributor."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Regulated natural gas utility with small propane delivery; utility economics differ from Par's refining and wholesale fuel business."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Distributes propane, heating oil, gasoline and diesel wholesale and to motor fuel customers, similar to Par's fuel marketing and logistics."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Railcar manufacturing, leasing and highway guardrail products; no fuel refining, distribution or retail fuel sales."}]}
